description: This file defines the interface for the high-level autohint module in the FreeType project, including function types, structures, and documentation related to automatic glyph hinting and global hints management.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalGetFunc
methods.description: Retrieves global hints for a face, returning a typeless pointer and size.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlobalResetFunc
methods.description: Recomputes global font metrics, useful when font data changes.

methods.name: FT_AutoHinter_GlyphLoadFunc
methods.description: Loads, scales, and hints a glyph from a face.
